# Griffiths Study

I need your help completing a research study on Griffiths rare-region effects (or their absence) in a phase field model of active tissue with quenched motility disorder, targeting Physical Review E. The central question is whether quenched cell-to-cell variability in self-propulsion speed produces the anomalous relaxation predicted by equilibrium Griffiths theory, or qualitatively different active-matter physics.

Before doing anything, please read these files to get up to speed:
1. The agent instructions: `.github/instructions/griffiths-study.instructions.md`
2. The study logbook: `cpp/simulation/study/griffiths/LOG_BOOK.md`
3. The manuscript: `cpp/simulation/study/griffiths/manuscript.tex` (search for `\TODO` markers)

After reading, give me a brief status summary: what experiments are complete, what data exists, what the manuscript needs, and what you recommend as the highest-priority next step. Don't start running anything yet.
